messages:
morgan: Heads-up — EU ingest spilled ~6h of late telemetry (kv_agg + hourly aggs). I want to propose a "rescue" recompute slot tonight 01:00-03:00 UTC to catch the hot hours before dashboards go stale. Thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kai: +1 on rescue slot if we can guarantee no impact on hosted low-latency traffic. can we run at low concurrency + preemptible GPUs?

priya: we should also consider routing: route rescue jobs through the "batch-rescue" priority lane with tenant quotas so one tenant doesn't hog the slot. add a per-tenant cap of 10 concurrent shards.

leo: Agree on cap. Also suggest we enable KV-cache prefill to reduce token work for large prefixes — that should cut cost and run-time.

morgan: good call on prefill. kai, do we have an existing runner that sets `--prefill-kv=true`?

kai: yes, runner v2 supports `--prefill-kv` but it spikes memory briefly. we can stagger shards to smooth.

priya: Console UX: can we add a temporary "rescue" flag on the backfill page so SRE/operators can opt into the quicker path? otherwise ops will DM you late.

sara: @priya +1. also add a warned estimated cost and ETA. people will ask whether this will affect billing/SLAs.

leo: routing detail — if rescue lane is full, fallback should be to the low-cost lane (slower). Do not fallback to production serving pool.

morgan: absolutely no fallback to prod-serving. we should add an explicit policy in the routing table: `if lane==rescue and full -> queue_in_rescue_waiter` rather than autofallback.

priya: quota enforcement plan: pre-check tokens per-tenant, reject over-quota with clear error, and offer UI link to request emergency quota. small script could auto-approve for infra-owned tenants.

kai: operationally: schedule job in two waves: wave A (critical tenants) at 01:00, wave B (bulk) at 01:30. each wave 45m work + 15m buffer. reduces memory spikes.

sara: can devops-bot post a checklist? e.g., "disable autoscaler bumping for nodes used by rescue" and monitor per-tenant token burn.

devops-bot: checklist generated: 1) ensure rescue lane active 2) set per-tenant cap 3) enable --prefill-kv staggered 4) disable node autoscaler for rescue pool 5) create alert on rescue-latency > 15s

leo: quick note about metrics: we need a dashboard tile for "rescue-run progress" showing processed_shards, ETA, and cost-estimate. otherwise product will ping mid-run.

morgan: ok agreed. I'll open a short PR to add the console flag + dashboard tile and update routing policy doc. who wants to own the run tonight?

priya: I can own operator handoff and quota approvals.

kai: I will own the runner config and submit the job. will post job id once started.

sara: I'll wire the dashboard tile and cost estimate.

morgan: perfect. final decision: run tonight 01:00-03:00 UTC, two waves, prefill-kv stagger, per-tenant cap 10, no fallback to prod. tagging the run `rescue-eu-389123`. thanks all. :tada:
